identity: Copperfell digs the copper Dur Brannoc runs on; bandits waylay the ore carts and a goblin foreman has opened an unlicensed dig above the seams.

quests.title: The Surveyor Has Tusks
quests.text: I paid a surveyor to mark our claims, and the Rooting Boars have submitted their own revisions. Kill eight of them in the {name:lower_pines} {zone_area:lower_pines} by day. We cannot run a mine on measurements taken by snout.
quests.lesson: Home zone neutrals; levels rise from the Hearthpine border.

quests.title: Keep the Rails Together
quests.text: Hear that clatter from the workyard? That's what a rail sounds like when its clamps have had enough. Bring me four Iron Bars and four Coal Lumps for replacements, and I'll give you an Iron Pickaxe for the harder rock below.
quests.lesson: Iron ore to bar; the Iron Pickaxe opens the next rock tier.

quests.title: An Appetite for Figures
quests.text: A Granary Rat ate six months of accounts last night and left the cover, which I consider criticism. Kill eight Granary Rats in the {name:lower_pines} after dark. Those books record what the miners are owed, and teeth are no excuse for missing wages.

quests.title: A Handle on the Problem
quests.text: Half the workyard is sharing one sound handle, and the other half is waiting to borrow it. Bring me three Ridged Boar Tusks from Rooting Boars in the {name:lower_pines} by day; any you saved will do. I'll see to the fitting, you see to the tusks.
quests.lesson: Save signature loot from earlier hunts.

quests.title: Orrik Sends Useful Hands
quests.text: Speak to Mara Deepwatch at Copperfell Outpost and tell her Orrik sent you; her latest request for help uses the word 'urgent' hard enough to tear the paper. I'd send a clerk, but she was quite specific about the axe.

quests.title: Bounty: Accounts Receivable, Barely
quests.text: Another page chewed, another bounty posted; at least this expense is easy to explain. Kill six Granary Rats in the {name:lower_pines} at night, then return for payment. This bounty is repeatable twenty minutes after you hand it in.

quests.title: The Road Has Gone Hollow
quests.text: A cart wheel went through the ground, and I've no wish to see a carter follow it. Hunt eight Burrow Gnawers after dark on the {name:pine_slopes} {zone_area:pine_slopes}. They tunnel while we sleep; tonight we interrupt the shift.
quests.lesson: Night hunt beside a day hunt in the same belt.

quests.title: Surefoot, Someone Else's Problem
quests.text: Surefoot Ibex never seem to fall, but everything they stand on does. Cull eight on the {name:pine_slopes} by day before another load of slate comes down on the carters.
quests.lesson: Daytime work while the gnawers sleep.

quests.title: A Toll Paid in Bruises
quests.text: The last carter to refuse their 'road toll' came back without his cart. Go to the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp} and defeat eight outlaws in all, counting Roadside Bandits and Bandit Lookouts. Use cover to close on the lookouts; an arrow doesn't care how stout your argument is.
quests.lesson: Melee and ranged outlaws in one camp.

quests.title: One Carter Still Missing
quests.text: Tovin Ashthumb hasn't come home, and I won't write his name under lost cargo. He's still a captive at the bandit camp you just raided; go speak with him while their watch is thin. He may know where the ore went, but first let him know we remembered him.

quests.title: The Guild's Good Name
quests.text: Every load we approve bears the guild seal, and I won't carve our name into rubbish. Bring me two pieces of Rough Jade from deep beneath the foothills, below the copper. Take your Iron Pickaxe, mind your light, and leave yourself a way back. I'd rather wait for the seal than replace the miner.
quests.lesson: Gems by depth; the iron pick reaches tier two rock.

quests.title: Bounty: Another Wheel Down
quests.text: I've patched the track, and something underneath is already undoing my work. Kill six Burrow Gnawers on the {name:pine_slopes} at night and report back for payment. This bounty is repeatable twenty minutes after you hand it in; I'll have the next shovel of gravel ready.

quests.title: I Know Where They Sold It
quests.text: They tied my hands, not my ears; I heard the bandits selling our ore to the goblins at the {name:goblin_dig} {dir_from_giver:goblin_dig}. Defeat eight of the dig's guards in all, counting Rubble Goblin Slingers and Ore-Guard Hounds. The slingers throw rocks and the hounds rush in, so don't let one distract you from the other.
quests.lesson: A goblin camp: ranged slingers with a melee hound.

quests.title: Our Wages, Nog's Problem
quests.text: Goblin Foreman Nog pays his crew out of Stolen Purses, which makes every carter here an unwilling investor. Bring back three Stolen Purses from Rubble Goblin Slingers at the {name:goblin_dig} and kill Nog himself there. Draw him away from his crew if you can. I'd like our wages back without owing you a funeral.
quests.lesson: Normal named leader at a camp; pull him alone.

quests.title: A Familiar Stamp
quests.text: I know the counting-house stamp on Nog's purses, and someone in Dur Brannoc has been putting a respectable seal on rotten business. Follow the main road to the capital and tell Dorrin Gateledger what we found.

quests.title: Bounty: Rocks in Lieu of Rent
quests.text: More Rubble Goblin Slingers have moved into the {name:goblin_dig}, and they're still throwing our mountain at us. Defeat six there and come back for your pay. This bounty is repeatable thirty minutes after you hand it in; I'll keep the account open.
